project_type: GitHub Pages static site (single-file HTML + Tailwind CSS + Vanilla JS) with GitHub Actions automation
build_system: None - static HTML served via GitHub Pages, no build step needed
test_framework: None - static single-file project, validation via manual inspection and YAML lint
build_command: N/A - no build step for static HTML
verification_instructions: 1. Verify index.html is valid HTML with proper structure. 2. Verify database.json is valid JSON (empty array). 3. Verify .github/workflows/alerts.yml is valid YAML with correct cron syntax. 4. Verify README.md describes the new CRM system.
setup_instructions: No setup needed - this is a static HTML project served by GitHub Pages
environment_constraints: This is a greenfield replacement of an existing repo. Must remove old files (index.html, src/, build.js, chatgpt-checkout.user.js, main.py, requirements.txt, package.json, .env.example) but keep .git directory and .gitignore
contribution_requirements: Complete replacement - no contribution guidelines from old project apply
key_patterns: Single-file HTML architecture. All frontend JS/CSS in index.html. Data persisted via GitHub API commits to database.json. GitHub Actions for automation.
directory_structure: Root: index.html (CRM dashboard), database.json (data store), README.md. .github/workflows/alerts.yml for automation.
